gaps.sentence: Also worth ___ is the museum's medieval wing.

We had no ___ signed the lease than the landlord sold the building.

gaps.sentence: Not until every passenger had been evacuated ___ the captain leave the ship.

gaps.sentence: Only by training every day ___ she hope to qualify.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the passengers instructed to stay seated.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I hung up than the phone rang again.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had I hung up than …' — the fixed inverted pair.
